name: Blackrock Spire (Lower encounters only)
overview: Lower Blackrock Spire only; provisional Classic advice. Pull one pack at a time and control casters. Upper Spire encounters and rare spawns are not covered.

sources.scope: Classic baseline only; not proof of unchanged Forever mechanics
Lower and Upper are separate roster units sharing Blackrock Spire; not a combat strategy guide
Forever-specific Lower guide remains Coming Soon; Classic advice stays provisional

bosses.name: Highlord Omokk
bosses.tip: Provisional Classic advice: Control the two ogre guards. Face Omokk away from allies and leave safe space for knockback.

bosses.name: Shadow Hunter Vosh'gajin
bosses.tip: Provisional Classic advice: Kill or control the two shadow priests. Remove Curse of Blood when possible; Hex can disable a party member.

bosses.name: War Master Voone
bosses.tip: Provisional Classic advice: Let the tank establish threat. Keep allies out of Voone's cleave and watch heavy tank damage.

bosses.name: Mother Smolderweb
bosses.tip: Provisional Classic advice: Face Smolderweb away from allies to avoid her frontal stun. Watch for Mother's Milk poison.

bosses.name: Urok Doomhowl
bosses.tip: Provisional Classic advice: Control the summoned ogre waves. Keep ranged players and the healer away from Urok's fear.

bosses.name: Quartermaster Zigris
bosses.tip: Provisional Classic advice: Clear nearby orc packs before engaging Zigris; avoid pulling the hall together.

bosses.name: Halycon
bosses.tip: Provisional Classic advice: Hold Halycon while the group kills her small worg adds, then focus her.

bosses.name: Gizrul the Slavener
bosses.tip: Provisional Classic advice: Expect heavy tank damage. Use available damage cooldowns to shorten the fight.

bosses.name: Overlord Wyrmthalak
bosses.tip: Provisional Classic advice: Tank with your back toward a safe wall and face Wyrmthalak away. Control the elite adds when they appear.

exclusion_reason: Upper events are positive raw rows but outside this slice. Rare spawns have no admitted strategy/event mapping; no absent-row claim or name/NPC fallback.
